Complete Hasse acyclicity is checked. The orbit graph construction for a translation is mathematically equivalent to the setwise-fixed flag faces. Its independence polynomial at -1 equals the reduced third-homology trace by an explicit orientation-sign Lefschetz identity. Exact integer orbit recurrences cover all 64 elements, separate direct signed face sums agree for each of ten symmetry types, exact Gaussian-integer Fourier sums give 64 nonnegative integer multiplicities summing to 405, and invariant-chain transfer proves the rational quotient homology. Limits: the scripts are finite and standard interpreter-dependent.

value.rationale: The natural composite-alphabet Hamming cube is an immediately motivated test of recently developed equivariant Vietoris–Rips theory. Unlike mere repetition of an adjacent nonequivariant wedge rank, the result gives a full 64-element character, 64 Fourier multiplicities, a meaningful order-two/order-four support refinement with traces 45 versus -3, and two concrete rational quotient homology ranks 9 and 71. These are substantive new topological invariants for a fixed canonical finite metric space, potentially informing general q-ary group-action formulas without alleging such a theorem here.
